hook: Put testimonials next to the ask — not on a testimonials page nobody visits.
direction: Social proof placement: beside donate buttons, on pricing, in signup flows. Proof answers the doubt at the exact moment it forms. Before/after wireframe graphic.

facebook.text:
Put testimonials next to the ask — not on a testimonials page nobody visits.

When someone hovers over your donate button, that's the moment doubt shows up. "Will this actually matter? Can I trust these people?" A testimonial sitting right there answers it before they click away.

Same goes for your pricing page, your volunteer signup, your newsletter form. Proof works where the decision is being made. Move it there.

instagram.text:
Put testimonials next to the ask — not on a testimonials page nobody visits.

The doubt forms at the donate button. At the signup form. At the pricing page. That's where your proof needs to be standing.

A dedicated testimonials page is better than nothing. But it's not where decisions happen. Place the right words at the right moment and you stop losing people who were already close to yes.

posts: Your testimonials page gets skipped. Put social proof next to the donate button, the signup form, the pricing — wherever the doubt actually forms. That's where it does its job. #nonprofitmarketing

data.title: Where to Put Your Social Proof
